meta.title: About us — Erveca Studio
meta.desc: Samuel Noval and Isabel López, founders of Erveca Studio in Pradillo, La Rioja, together with collaborators such as Daniel Aguirre of Badabum Music Studio.
hero.label: The team
hero.title: Two people, one village
hero.lead: Erveca Studio is, above all, a life project in Pradillo, a village of just over sixty inhabitants in the Cameros mountains, La Rioja.
samuel.alt: Samuel Noval, developer at Erveca Studio
samuel.bio: Also known as Samuyo96, Samuel leads the development and programming of Erveca Studio's games in Unity, from the technical architecture to the implementation of every mechanic.
isabel.alt: Isabel López Sierra, designer at Erveca Studio
isabel.bio: Isabel is in charge of design at Erveca Studio, balancing the project with her job as a kitchen assistant and her studies. Her eye shapes the visual and narrative universe of every game.
collab.title: Collaborations
collab.intro: Samuel and Isabel are joined by occasional collaborations with other professionals who bring their craft to each project.
daniel.bio: Composer of the original soundtrack for Erveca Studio's games.
pradillo.alt: View of the village of Pradillo, La Rioja
base.label: Our home base
base.title: Pradillo, Camero Nuevo
base.p1: Pradillo is a small municipality in the Riojan mountains, in the Camero Nuevo region, at 880 metres above sea level. With just over sixty inhabitants, it is the place where each of our projects is born and developed.
base.p2: Working from here is not a limitation: it is the reason Erveca Studio exists. We believe the rural world can be a place from which to create digital culture with its own identity, and our games are how we give back to the village what it gives us.
